objective: Develop and independently verify accurate, efficient full-state fluid generators for all 12 combinations of output intervals of 1/30, 1/60 and 1/120 second and K = 1, 2, 3 or 4 consecutive outputs per pass. Reduce expensive internal substeps and share temporal computation so each pass advances K whole output intervals. Expand independent 20-second training simulations integrated at 240 reference steps per second; train explicit longer endpoint transitions and every intermediate state. Compare learned substep corrections, shared endpoint/intermediate generation and cheap guidance available during deployment. Pursue worst equation, pressure, velocity and tracer errors no greater than 1e-5 and complete GPU generation latency no greater than 1.2 ms per physical output on a 32 x 32 x 32 grid. Preserve smaller-grid regressions and the existing voxel-proportional latency ceiling for larger domains. Require independent-scene verification and keep GPU and CPU claims separate. After the accuracy, speed and scaling gates succeed, minimize drift over 600 physical steps at 30 and 60 simulation outputs per second.

resume_from.current_result: S4 direct correction loss fell by 2.785 percent, but 1,151 of 2,120 native outputs still fail. Worst equation error is 0.015174423298219157. The candidate is retained, not promoted; no combined target has been achieved.

temporal_contract.example: K=4 at 60 simulation outputs per second advances 4/60 second and returns states at 1/60, 2/60, 3/60 and 4/60 second. It spans 16 reference updates, not 4.
temporal_contract.core_success_measure: Generate the same physical simulation duration and output sequence with less complete GPU wall time, preserving every physical state and endpoint continuation.
temporal_contract.rendering_fps_and_force_frequency: Separate metadata; neither determines the physical integration interval or the force spectrum.

ordered_work.name: Qualify the longer reference capture contract
actions: Extend the existing fixed 1/60-second capture and fixed 1/480-second correction assumptions in new versioned sources; support explicit timestamps, localdt and block duration.
Run a four-scene pilot spanning force families, motion, grid density and domain shapes at 240 reference updates/second over 20 seconds.

Check native stability, actual timestamps, uninterrupted evolution, complete-state restart fidelity, force evaluation at actual fine physical times and reference accuracy against available finer comparisons.
Report any failure or accuracy gap at 240 without silently changing the chosen reference rate, force parameters, tolerances or reference lineage.
Measure capture time, memory and retained-window storage; freeze the finite scene manifest and resource budget from those measurements before broad capture.

ordered_work.name: Expand independent scene diversity and build full-state targets
actions: Initial proposed expansion:36 independent 20-second master trajectories,24 training and12 development, with the four-scene pilot included in those 36.

Cross continuous, continuously varying, regular-pulse and irregular-pulse forcing with stationary, oscillating and moving/reflected source paths; vary initial conditions, strength, position, radius, pulse schedule and motion parameters.

Preserve densities of 8, 10, 16, 25, 50 and 100 cells per metre and varied cubic, rectangular and rotated-aspect domains. Retain small controls, include domains above 32 cubed, and expand expensive volumes according to measured capture budgets.
Separate active correction-supervision coverage from unchanged one-substep controls; fill the current regular-pulse correction-label gap.
Split physical scenario groups before constructing windows. Related realizations, rescaled variants and timestep views remain in one split; do not count 12 views as 12 independent simulations.

Stream all fine integration updates, retaining selected complete windows distributed throughout 20 seconds, including transitions and late dynamics. Do not repeat a 4-second forcing schedule to manufacture 20 seconds.
Retain complete pressure, staggered velocity, tracer, required continuation history, matching reference RHS, grid/material metadata, known control schedules and exact physical timestamps.

Construct explicit start-to-endpoint labels for all 12 cases and every interior state. Retain fine intermediates or derived missing-correction labels for substep training. Future reference fields remain targets only.

ordered_work.name: Improve the learned reduction of internal substeps
actions: Retain the accurate baseline. Treat the S4 fit as measured negative/limited evidence, not a successful successor or proof that 24 iterations exhaust the architecture.

Test finite, predeclared hypotheses: normalized direct correction plus coupled physical supervision; useful coarse predicted pressure/velocity context; or a controlled optimization continuation with scene-balanced sampling.
Score every field and physical output. Do not select a successor solely from lower average correction loss or from easy one-substep cases.
Profile complete GPU execution and compare error reduction per millisecond; keep failed candidates and their measured timings for review.

ordered_work.name: Train generators that share work across longer physical horizons
actions: Train direct endpoints at K * output_dt for every K and every output interval, rather than expecting shorter-interval training to cover longer transitions automatically.
Compare the sequential K-step baseline against one shared encoder/direct endpoint and a smaller decoder for all intermediate states.
Compare no additional guidance, exact prescribed-control-path guidance and one profiled physical-field guide. Count all dependencies and identify any runtime numerical operations explicitly.
Use model-predicted endpoints and deployment-available guidance when training/evaluating intermediate decoders. True future endpoints or reference fields may be offline oracle diagnostics only.
Do not call tracer or RHS guidance exact when it depends on predicted intermediate velocities. Do not hide a full native pressure solve or K full reference advances inside guide preparation.
Keep full-AI learned pressure/dynamics as the primary development track. Any extra numerical-field-guidance variant must be identified and compared explicitly.
Keep diffusion as an optional later refinement/noise-training investigation. Admit extra inference passes only when their measured accuracy benefit justifies their complete cost.

ordered_work.name: Freeze candidates and verify accuracy, speed and scaling
actions: Evaluate every requested state and endpoint with frozen equation, pressure, velocity and tracer metrics, including declared near-zero handling.

Report separate results for outputdt, K, lead time, density, grid counts/aspect ratio, force family and scene split. Publish maxima and failures; do not substitute a best-case point for model-wide qualification.
Use independent-scene development checks, then frozen additional-seed and reserved-scene confirmation. Do not relabel development cases used for architecture tuning as untouched tests.
Use separate diagnostic fits for unseen-duration tests. Exclude held-out elapsed times across all output heads and auxiliary targets; production training still includes all 12 cases.

Measure complete GPU block latency, latency/K, simulated seconds per wall second and total time for identical physical-duration outputs. Include controls, encoder, endpoint prediction, guides, all state reconstruction, continuation history, transfers and synchronization.
Record setup/warm-up separately; report median, p95 and maximum observed latency, hardware, precision and memory. Compare 32 cubed and matched-aspect larger grids; retain all prior maxima.
Require actual measured accuracy and speed together before promotion or goal completion. GPU results must not be presented as CPU results.

ordered_work.name: Minimize autonomous long-run drift after the preceding gates
actions: Run 600 physical simulation steps at 60 outputs per second (10seconds) and 30 outputs per second (20 seconds), for K = 1, 2, 3 and 4, without reference-state resets.
Also compare equal physical durations across output rates, keeping the number of generated states and simulation time explicit.
Measure full error curves, divergence, boundary flux, tracer mass/bounds, energy behavior, block-boundary artifacts and time to the existing diagnostic drift thresholds.
Application-specific unacceptable-drift limits remain unset by user choice; retain diagnostic thresholds and do not invent an application acceptance limit.
Minimize measured drift while preserving prior accuracy and latency constraints; report the best verified finite result rather than claiming a global optimum.

acceptance.larger_domain_per_step_budget: 1.2 * max(1, Nx * Ny * Nz / 32768) milliseconds; prefer sub-voxel-proportional scaling.
acceptance.latency_interpretation: Maximum observed complete-block latency/K over the frozen finite population; also report medians and p95. This is not a hard-real-time guarantee.
acceptance.device_rule: Use GPU for ongoing learned inference and CUDA training. Label timings as GPU. Preserve the historical CPU-optimized reproduction recipe and distinguish historical CPU targets; a GPU pass is not CPU qualification.
acceptance.confirmation: All 12 cadence/K combinations, complete intermediate outputs, independent-scene verification and required seed characterization; no promotion on training loss or an isolated speed/accuracy row.

execution_rules.training: Existing managed Tuldok CUDA workflow with exact typed CPU parameter restores and copied GPU probes; no CPU learned forwards.
execution_rules.authorization: Previously authorized saved owner session and normal local renewal only; do not inspect alternate credentials.
execution_rules.integrity: Create new versioned source, plan, reference-lineage and result files. Preserve existing immutable scientific bindings, failed evidence and unrelated dirty files.
execution_rules.independence: Keep the 52 reserved reference outputs unopened during model/data design and training; freeze final confirmation before reading them.
execution_rules.resources: Use measured finite capture/fit budgets and explicit job custody; preserve and reconcile interrupted jobs before submitting replacements.
execution_rules.reporting: Report hypotheses, actual fits, unchanged controls, independent scenes, complete-state accuracy, measured GPU cost and limitations separately. Keep a current checkpoint and next concrete experiment.
execution_rules.completion: Mark complete only when all required model, independent accuracy/speed/scaling and gated drift objectives are verified; planning, fitting or better training loss alone is not completion.
